title: claudex plan revision artifact, version 1
description: A hash-guarded revision of an agreed plan: a baseline digest plus section replacements (null preserves the baseline section) and point-by-point responses to critique findings. Submitted for a plan-revise phase.

protocol_version.description: The protocol major version; always 1 for this schema.

message_type.description: Discriminates this message from other protocol messages.

turn_id.description: The turn this revision is submitted for.

state_revision.description: The run-state revision this submit must compare-and-swap against.

human_context.description: Disclosed local human/agent dialogue that changed requirements this turn; null when none.

requires_human_decision.description: True only for an unresolved value choice that must escalate to the human.

decision_question.description: The concrete question for the human, else null.

base_plan_sha256.description: Lower-hex sha256 of the baseline plan this revision is guarded against.

plan_markdown.description: Replacement architecture/decisions, or null to preserve the baseline section. A non-null replacement must be non-empty, so a materialized plan can never lose its required prose.

steps.description: Replacement full step list, or null to preserve it.

description.description: Concrete file-level work; independently implementable and committable.

tests.description: Tests this step adds or updates.

risks.description: Replacement risk list, or null to preserve it.

open_questions.description: Replacement open-question list, or null to preserve it.

finding_key.description: The critique finding key this responds to.

finding.description: Restatement of the finding being answered.

action.description: Whether the finding was accepted or rebutted.

rationale.description: For rebuttals: direct repository evidence, or it does not count.
